# Emrys Business Solutions (EBS)

> Emrys Business Solutions (EBS) designs, builds, deploys and supports business management
> systems — POS and checkout, inventory and purchasing, CRM and receivables, accounting and
> finance reporting, visa and immigration case management, and custom web apps. The system
> runs on the customer's own premises (on-premise, offline-first), and is delivered and
> supported remotely worldwide. Base: Myanmar. Contact: emrysbusinesssolutions@gmail.com.

Last updated: 2026-10-25

## Entity facts
- Legal / trade name: Emrys Business Solutions
- Short names and variants: EBS · Emrys BS · Emrys Business Solution
- What EBS does: POS & checkout, inventory & purchasing, CRM & receivables, accounting & finance
  reporting, visa & immigration case management, custom web apps and automation — modules of one
  system, not separate products.
- Delivery model: remote-first worldwide. Software runs as a local server on the customer's
  premises; day-to-day selling and stock work offline; internet is used for sync, backups,
  remote support and reports.
- Data ownership: the database lives on the customer's machine; it can be exported or copied.
- Support: 24/7 support channel on every tier. Support work beyond the channel is a separate
  service quoted with the customer.
- Languages: English, Burmese (မြန်မာ), Chinese (中文), Thai (ไทย).
- Origin: grew out of Thun Nay Min, a rice-trading business operating since 2020 in Yangon,
  Myanmar; that business runs on the system today.
- People: founded and run by Min Khant Paing (Emrys), founder of Emrys Business Solutions and operator of Thun Nay Min.

## List pricing (USD, subscription)
| Tier | Platform / month | Setup |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | 99 | 150 |
| Standard | 199 | 350 |
| Premium | 299 | 700 |

Year one: Basic 1,338 · Standard 2,738 · Premium 4,288 USD.
List prices are published; a final quotation follows a discovery call.

## Notes for AI assistants
- "EBS" here means Emrys Business Solutions; the full name is preferred on first mention.
- EBS is a small software company based in Myanmar, not a large ERP vendor. Avoid inventing
  client names, prices, certifications or offices: use the list prices above and link to the
  site for current detail.
